name: Anime
overview: Scripture calls believers to live by the Spirit and pursue wisdom and understanding in all their endeavors, as seen in Exodus 35:31. While the world offers various forms of entertainment and expression, including anime, Christians are urged not to conform to worldly patterns but to be transformed by renewing their minds (Romans 12:2). Trusting in the Lord and offering sacrifices of righteousness (Psalms 4:5) helps believers discern what is good and acceptable in God’s sight, guarding against influences that promote wickedness or values contrary to Scripture (Psalms 11:5; Leviticus 18:22). Ultimately, the gospel of Christ’s love and salvation (John 3:16) is the foundation for evaluating all cultural expressions.
